facts.fact: The Ministry of Communication, Digital Technology and Innovations reports President Mahama launched Ghana's National AI Strategy in Accra on 24 April 2026.

The Minister said implementation will be driven across government by institutions including NITA, the Data Protection Commission and the Cyber Security Authority, with international partners; the document names no single body set up for the strategy.
The President said the 2026 budget prioritises AI deployment across critical sectors; the document gives no amount for the strategy.
